3:12 p.m. Weather conditions: air temperature 69 degrees, relative humidity 52 percent, barometer 29.99 inches, adjusted altitude 2,252 feet, track temperature 102 degrees.

Prock is 5 - 1 against Wilkerson in prior events. 

Prock hits the throttle and goes up in smoke. Wilkerson goes down the groove with his quickest pass of the weekend to take the win.

Daniel Wilkerson's incremental times: 60ft-0.888 sec., 330ft-2.262, 660ft-3.172/284.87 mph. 

Wilkerson is going to his seventh career final round, his third this year.

DeJoria is 11 - 10 against Todd in prior events. 

Todd gets out of the gate first but DeJoria starts making up ground. She continues to gain ground but Todd is able to hold her off and take the holeshot win.

J.R. Todd's incremental margins: 60ft(0.025), 330 ft(0.017), 660ft(0.007).  MOV: 0.0088 seconds (approximately 4 feet).

Todd is going to his 53rd final round, his fourth this year.

If Todd wins the final he will win the championship. If he doesn't, Hagan will win the championship.
